interface.shortDescription: Belgian company data from the official registers
interface.longDescription:
Ask about any Belgian company and get answers from the official sources: the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises register, the annual accounts filed with the National Bank of Belgium and the Belgian Official Gazette, refreshed every night.

Look up a company by name, enterprise or VAT number; read its key figures, directors, shareholders and publications; run a due-diligence check with the health score, insolvency notices, the 30bis/30ter withholding obligation and sanctions screening; or build a prospect list ranked on revenue or staff.

Sign in with your firmbase account when you connect. Every tool call counts on your firmbase plan; the register tools are free.
